tasks.title: Reach the Safari Zone secret house and get HM03 in one entry
tasks.goal: You have just entered the Safari Zone with 500 steps. Find the secret house deep in the zone and get the HM the man there gives away. When the steps run out you are sent back to the gate, and you cannot afford a second entry, so the task fails if you return to the gate. Wild encounters are disabled.
tasks.start: The Safari Zone center area, on the entrance tile from the gate, with 500 steps and 30 Safari Balls. HM03 has not been given and the player has too little money to pay for another entry.

tasks.title: Open both trash can locks in the Vermilion Gym and reach Lt. Surge
tasks.goal: Two electric locks seal Lt. Surge's end of the Vermilion Gym. Find the switches hidden in the gym's trash cans, open both locks and walk up to Lt. Surge. You do not need to battle him. Wild encounters are disabled and the gym trainers are already beaten.
tasks.start: The Vermilion Gym, just inside the door. Both electric locks are shut, every gym trainer is beaten and Lt. Surge is not.

tasks.title: Defeat the Champion's six with three Pokemon, no items and no faint
tasks.goal: Defeat the Champion, then complete the Hall of Fame registration. You have three Pokemon against six and the bag is empty. The task fails the moment any of your Pokemon faints. Do not nickname Pokemon.
tasks.start: The Champion battle in the Champion's room, at the first battle menu. Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha and Lance are beaten, the Champion is not and the Hall of Fame is empty.

tasks.title: Defeat the Elite Four and the Champion with no items and no faint
tasks.goal: Defeat Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha, Lance and the Champion, then complete the Hall of Fame registration. The bag is empty, so nothing heals the party between battles. The task fails the moment any of your Pokemon faints. Do not nickname Pokemon.
tasks.start: Lorelei's room at the Pokemon League, just inside the door. All eight badges are owned, no Elite Four member or Champion has been defeated and the Hall of Fame is empty.

tasks.title: Fetch a drink for the thirsty guard and enter Saffron City
tasks.goal: Get into Saffron City. The guards in its gates turn travelers away, so find out what they want, get it and pass a gate into the city. Do not nickname Pokemon.
tasks.start: Inside the gate between Route 7 and Saffron City, just east of the Route 7 door. No guard has been given a drink, the bag and the PC item storage are empty and the player has 500 money.
